question: Should OpenClaw remove these released bundled skill identifiers now and ship Sherpa ONNX TTS as an official ClawHub-only plugin once migration and trust gates are satisfied?
rationale: The code direction fits lean-core and plugin ownership, but only maintainers can accept the user-facing deprecation contract and official package/artifact trust boundary.

options.title: Add migration and land
options.body: Keep the current direction, add the doctor migration and upgrade proof, then authorize the exact dependency graph and Sherpa artifact path before merge.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Move the Sherpa plugin and ClawHub-only install support into a narrower PR while deferring the broad bundled-skill removal.

options.title: Park the trim
options.body: Retain the current bundled set until a release-owned deprecation and migration plan is ready.

recommendation.title: Add migration and land
recommendation.body: Keep the current direction, add the doctor migration and upgrade proof, then authorize the exact dependency graph and Sherpa artifact path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the related split-work context, is assigned here, and has the strongest recent evidence trail for the remaining decision surface.
